subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after the serialization and proof blockers are addressed?
rationale: There are two open candidate PRs for the same issue, and automation cannot safely choose between this smaller branch and the broader sibling branch while both remain proof-gated and one sibling is conflicting.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON regression, and includes accessible real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape and it is rebased with reviewable proof.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the candidate if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON regression, and includes accessible real app-server/plugin proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the Codex dynamic-tool bridge and protocol surface involved in this choice.
